description: This file defines and manages command registration for a CLI application, including core commands, subcommands, and lazy registration logic.

methods.name: shouldRegisterCorePrimaryOnly
methods.description: Determines if only the primary command should be registered based on argv.

methods.name: removeEntryCommands
methods.description: Removes existing commands from the program before re-registering.

methods.name: registerLazyCoreCommand
methods.description: Registers a core command lazily with the program.

methods.name: registerCoreCliByName
methods.description: Registers a core CLI command by its name.

methods.name: registerCoreCliCommands
methods.description: Registers all core CLI commands, or only the primary if specified.

methods.name: registerProgramCommands
methods.description: Registers core and sub-CLI commands for the program.

calls: registerLazyCommand({ program, name, description, removeNames, register })
